vsftpd.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a known backdoor vulnerability.
vsftpd.recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd immediately and audit FTP accounts.

vsftpd.description: Older vsftpd versions may be affected by the ALPACA cross-protocol attack.
vsftpd.recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd and disable plain FTP where possible.

openssh.description: A vulnerability in ssh-agent forwarding can allow remote code execution.
openssh.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH and disable SSH agent forwarding unless required.

openssh.description: A race condition in OpenSSH may allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

apache httpd.description: Path traversal and remote code execution vulnerability in affected Apache versions.
Apache mod_proxy vulnerability affecting certain configurations.
apache httpd.recommendation: Upgrade Apache and review reverse proxy configuration.
Upgrade Apache and review mod_rewrite configuration.

nginx.description: A DNS resolver vulnerability can cause memory corruption and denial of service.
nginx.recommendation: Upgrade Nginx and restrict DNS resolver access.

openssl.description: A malformed certificate can trigger an infinite loop and denial of service.
openssl.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSL to a supported security release.

openssl.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability exists in X.509 certificate processing.
openssl.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSL to a patched version.

samba.description: A writable Samba share can potentially be abused for remote code execution.
samba.recommendation: Upgrade Samba and restrict writable shares.

mysql.description: An authentication bypass vulnerability affects certain MySQL versions.
mysql.recommendation: Upgrade MySQL and rotate database credentials.

proftpd.description: A mod_copy vulnerability can allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
proftpd.recommendation: Upgrade ProFTPD and disable mod_copy if not required.
